title: ooRexx pitfalls met while building it
summary: Faults found and fixed in this lane, each a rule for the next change.
invariants: An attribute never set answers its own name in upper case (ID), not .nil: objects made by a session set unset attributes to .nil.
A literal followed by a blank and a symbol b or x can read as a binary or hex string ("...~"b "= ..."): use || b.
SIGNAL inside a DO loop ends every active loop: a label used by SIGNAL ON goes in a helper method, not inside a loop.
call self~x is not a message call: write self~x as a message instruction.
parse var s before "%" n +1 s: +1 counts from the start of the matched literal; split by hand.
A comment that contains a slash and star opens a nested comment (data/*.cls inside a comment).
A JSON boolean from ADDRESS FETCH JSON is a JSONBoolean: read its ~value.
SysFileTree answers absolute names: compare with an absolute destination (.File~new(d)~absolutePath).
A relative database path fails in the browser: oodBeside resolves it beside the program.
Values for SQL go through NoSQLServer's DatabasePreparedStatement and DatabaseParameterBinder typed from the catalogue: an untyped 1 became '1'.

provenance.claim: The model, catalogue, generator and reader.
